name: PR triage
description: Classify a pull request from its title, description and diff summary.
state:
Title: Add rate limiting to the public /v2/search endpoint

Description:
Search traffic from a handful of API keys has been saturating the cluster. This PR adds a token-bucket limiter (100 req/min per API key, burst 20) in the gateway middleware. Exceeding the limit returns 429 with a Retry-After header. Limits are configurable via SEARCH_RATE_LIMIT_* env vars. Added unit tests for the bucket and an integration test for the 429 path. No changes to the response schema for successful requests.

change_kind.instructions: Classify the primary intent of this pull request. If it mixes kinds, pick the one that best explains why the PR exists.

criteria.feature: Adds new user-visible or API-visible behavior that did not exist before.
criteria.bugfix: Corrects behavior that was wrong relative to the intended spec.
criteria.refactor: Restructures code without changing observable behavior.
criteria.chore: Maintenance: dependency bumps, tooling, CI, formatting, housekeeping.
criteria.test: Only tests are added or changed.

risk.instructions: How risky is merging this PR as-is? Consider blast radius, reversibility, test coverage, and whether it touches request handling on hot paths.

criteria.definition: Docs, comments, tests only, or dead code. Cannot affect production behavior.
Small, well-tested, easily reverted change in a non-critical path.
Touches a shared or hot path, or changes behavior for some users; tests exist but edge cases are plausible.
Could reject or corrupt production traffic, change data, or affect all users; hard to roll back or lightly tested.

needs_security_review.instructions: Should a security engineer review this PR before merge?

true.covers: Authentication, authorization, secrets, crypto, input parsing of untrusted data, new network exposure, rate limiting or abuse controls, dependency with known CVEs.

false.covers: Pure UI, docs, tests, internal refactors with no trust-boundary changes.

touches_public_api.instructions: Does this PR change the externally observable contract of a public API: routes, request or response schema, status codes, headers, or documented limits?

description_quality.instructions: Rate the PR description on whether a reviewer can understand the motivation, the approach, and how it was verified without reading the diff.
criteria: Missing or a single vague line.
States what changed but not why or how it was tested.
Explains what and why; testing is mentioned but thin.
Explains motivation, approach, configuration, testing, and compatibility impact.

suggested_reviewer_team.instructions: Which team should own the review, based on the files and the nature of the change?

criteria.backend: Application services, API routes, middleware, business logic.
criteria.frontend: Web or mobile UI code, client-side state, styling.
criteria.infra: Deployment, Kubernetes, CI pipelines, observability, cloud config.
